Install Instructions — XtremeFork-Universal (GTA V Enhanced & Legacy):

1. Download the latest release package (XtremeFork-Universal-Windows-x64.zip) from the GitHub Releases tab.
2. Ensure ScriptHookV (ScriptHookV.dll + ASI Loader) is installed in your game folder.
3. Extract XtremeTool.asi and XtremeTool.ini into your main GTA V directory:
   - GTA V Enhanced (v1.0.811.8 – v1.0.1158.13+): where GTA5_Enhanced.exe is located.
   - GTA V Legacy   (v1.0.3095.0 – v1.0.3889.0+): where GTA5.exe is located.
3. XtremeFork-Universal automatically detects whether you are running GTA V Enhanced or GTA V Legacy at startup.
4. Check out Documentation_Config.txt for an explanation of all parameters in XtremeTool.ini.
